definitions.explanation: The coldest climatic zones of the Earth, located around the Arctic and Antarctic poles.

examples.japanese: {寒帯|かんたい}では{一年中|いちねんじゅう}{寒|さむ}い。
examples.english: It's cold all year round in the frigid zone.

examples.japanese: {北極|ほっきょく}と{南極|なんきょく}は{寒帯|かんたい}に{属|ぞく}する。
examples.english: The Arctic and Antarctic belong to the frigid zone.

examples.japanese: {寒帯|かんたい}の{動物|どうぶつ}は{厳|きび}しい{環境|かんきょう}に{適応|てきおう}している。
examples.english: Animals in the frigid zone have adapted to harsh conditions.

notes:
GEOGRAPHY: {寒帯|かんたい} refers to the climate zones between the polar circles and the poles.

CLIMATE ZONES ({気候帯|きこうたい}):
・{熱帯|ねったい} - tropical zone (hottest)
・{亜熱帯|あねったい} - subtropical zone
・{温帯|おんたい} - temperate zone
・{亜寒帯|あかんたい}/{冷帯|れいたい} - subarctic zone
・{寒帯|かんたい} - frigid zone (coldest)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{寒帯|かんたい}{気候|きこう} (frigid climate)
・{寒帯|かんたい}{地方|ちほう} (frigid regions)

RELATED:
・{北極圏|ほっきょくけん} - Arctic Circle
・{南極圏|なんきょくけん} - Antarctic Circle
